record.field: Change one or more whitelisted settings, e.g. "turn on multi-currency", "فعّل الإكراميات في نقطة البيع". Call with no arguments to list the options this user may change (code, current value, choices). settings = {code: value}; booleans take true/false, selections take a choice label, taxes take the tax name. Only PROPOSES: the user sees old → new and must press Confirm. Only administrators can apply settings.
Turn whitelisted settings on or off after the user confirms.

When the user asks to enable, disable or change a setting (فعّل، عطّل، اضبط الإعدادات), call `update_settings`. If you do not know the option code, call it with no arguments first to list what is allowed, then call it again with settings = {code: value}. Never claim a change is applied before the user confirms. If the option is not in the list, say it is not something the assistant can change and offer to open Settings instead.
